evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 is 4.8 ppm after purge, the same as the ramp baseline of about 4-7 ppm.
Exhaust O2 rose steadily during growth: 8.4, 13.9, 16.2, then 21.9 ppm.
Ar flow holds at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the MFC looks normal and dilution is unchanged.
T is steady at about 750 °C and heater power is steady at about 45%, so the thermal system looks normal.
No pressure gauge is installed, so a seal leak cannot be told apart from an exhaust blockage or back-diffusion by pressure.

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure readings, or a leak test: raise Ar flow and see whether O2 drops, which would mean air is coming in at a fixed rate. Also a pressure-decay or helium-sniff check of the seals, and ref statistics for O2 during growth.
